about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-coverage target. The first byte picks the formats: bit 0 coverage format 2, bit 1 single substitution format 2, bits 2 and 3 class definition format 2 for the first and second glyph, bits 4 and 5 a third class of each. Each further byte (up to 32) chooses a run of covered glyphs, kerning values and the text. The font is built from 2 and 16 copies of the runs.

seeds.why: coverage format 1, delta substitution, class definitions format 1, two classes
both class definitions format 2, three classes each
one long run (byte 0xff: gap 0, longest run)
no choice bytes: one run from byte 0
